targets.query: SELECT mean("signal") AS "Signal" FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "strategy" fill(none)

SELECT max("fillPrice") AS "BUY" FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategyFill" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/ AND "execside" = 'buy') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "strategy", "aggressorIndicator"::tag fill(none)
SELECT max("price") FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategyOrder" WHERE ("side" = 'buy' AND "strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "strategy" fill(none)
SELECT max("price") FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategyOrder" WHERE ("side" = 'sell' AND "strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "strategy" fill(none)
SELECT mean("pnl") FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "strategy" fill(none)

sells = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategyFill" and r.execside == "sell")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${Strategy:regex}/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.fillPrice * r.qtyFloat, strategy: r.strategy}))
  |> group(columns: ["strategy"])
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["_value"])

buys = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategyFill" and r.execside == "buy")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${Strategy:regex}/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: -1.0 * r.fillPrice * r.qtyFloat, strategy: r.strategy}))
  |> group(columns: ["strategy"])
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["_value"])

union(tables: [sells, buys])
  |> group(columns: ["strategy"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["_value"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "strategy"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "window pnl"})
